target: observe_push.sh — cursor advances on store ack, holds on failure, pushes only the delta
cmd:
mkdir -p .agentic/observability bin; cp "$FIXTURES/obs-events.jsonl" .agentic/observability/events-20260728.jsonl; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true,"stack":{"enabled":true}}}' > .agentic/config.json; printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 0
' > bin/curl-ok; printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 22
' > bin/curl-dead; chmod +x bin/curl-ok bin/curl-dead; export O2_URL=http://localhost:5080 O2_AUTH=a:b; O2_CURL="$PWD/bin/curl-dead" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_push.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; DEAD_EC=$?; HELD="$(jq -r '.["events-20260728.jsonl"] // 0' .agentic/observability/state/push-cursor.json)"; O2_CURL="$PWD/bin/curl-ok" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_push.sh" >/dev/null; AFTER="$(jq -r '.["events-20260728.jsonl"]' .agentic/observability/state/push-cursor.json)"; SECOND="$(O2_CURL="$PWD/bin/curl-ok" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_push.sh" | tail -1)"; jq -n --argjson dead "$DEAD_EC" --argjson held "$HELD" --argjson after "$AFTER" --arg second "$SECOND" '{dead: $dead, held: $held, after: $after, second: $second}'
